content: Hi all — John Erlbacher, independent researcher. I run a verification-first, AI-assisted mathematics pipeline (Demonstrandum): results are only accepted on machine-checkable artifacts — Lean kernel proofs where possible, exact certificates + independent checkers otherwise, with the AI involvement always disclosed. Lean work so far includes a kernel-verified constant for union-closed families and a disproof of a published lattice-Borsuk conjecture (both with pinned toolchains + axiom audit scripts in a public repo). I'll post details in the appropriate streams — glad to be here, and grateful for scrutiny; that's the point of the operation.
